title: Solidity Auditor Finding Record v3
description: The wire format every hunt agent MUST emit. One JSON object per candidate. Agents write a JSON Lines file (one record per line) to the ledger. Free-text prose is NOT a valid agent output in v3.

kind.description: FINDING requires proof. LEAD is an unverified trail. AXISGAP is emitted by the orchestrator, not by agents. COVERAGE_NOTE records what the agent examined and cleared.

agent_id.description: Slug of the specialty, e.g. 'access-control', 'numerical-gap'. NOT an index number - indices break when routing changes the roster.

file.description: Repo-relative path. Strongly recommended; the reducer uses it to disambiguate same-named contracts.

function.description: Function or modifier name. Use 'constructor', 'receive', 'fallback', or '<contract-level>' where no single function applies. Function isolation in reduction is keyed on this - it is never merged across values.

group_key.description: Canonical dedup key: '<contract>|<function>|<bug_class>'. MUST be exactly those three fields joined by '|' with no spaces.

domain.description: Optional. Set by domain and proof specialists.

axes.description: Which of the six risk axes this record covers. Drives the mechanical axis-coverage gate - an agent that never sets axes cannot close coverage.

severity_claim.description: The AGENT's claim, pre-judging. The orchestrator assigns final severity after gating; this field is never rewritten in place.

description.description: One to three sentences. What breaks and who is harmed.

root_cause.description: One sentence, code-level. Required for FINDING.

path.description: caller -> function -> state change -> impact. A concrete call chain, not a category.

proof.description: REQUIRED for kind=FINDING. Absent or empty => the record MUST be emitted as LEAD.

fix.description: One fix per record. Distinct fixes for the same (contract, function) MUST arrive as separate records or in `alternatives` - never collapsed into prose.

label.description: Fix taxonomy. The reducer treats different labels as automatically distinct fixes.

diff.description: Unified diff body. `-` and `+` lines only, no file headers required.

add_lines.description: The `+` lines alone, normalized. The reducer hashes these to decide fix distinctness mechanically instead of asking an LLM.

alternatives.description: Additional distinct fixes the same agent considered. Preserved verbatim through reduction.

devils_advocate.description: The six-dimension DA record. Every dimension needs a one-line note AND a machine verdict.

verdict.description: Agent's own call after running all six. Any dimension with blocks=true and no stated bypass MUST NOT produce 'survives'.

code.description: Test source. For status=compiled/passing this MUST be the exact source that was run.

command.description: Exact command used, e.g. 'forge test --match-test testExploit -vvv'.

why_not.description: REQUIRED when status='not-feasible'. Must be code-grounded, not 'no time'.

seam.description: Gap-hunter only: which two or three lenses combine.

guard_gap.description: Access-control only: the missing guard plus the parallel function that has it.

corroboration.description: Populated by the reducer, not the agent. Agent ids that independently reported the same group_key.

verification.description: Populated by the adversarial verifier in the VERIFY phase. Agents MUST NOT write this.

refutation.description: The strongest counter-argument found, always recorded - even when the finding survives.

counter_evidence.description: Quoted code or trace supporting the refutation.

residual_risk.description: What remains true even if the headline claim was refuted. Often becomes a LEAD.

confidence.description: Computed by confidence.md formula. Never hand-picked.

telemetry.description: Optional per-record observability. The orchestrator aggregates these into run.json.

blocks.description: true = this dimension materially blocks exploitation.

bypass.description: Required when blocks=true but the agent still claims the finding survives. Must name the concrete bypass.
